entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kidin-Hutran was a middle-Elamite king of the Igihalkid dynasty known for his wars with Babylonia. The Babylonian Chronicle P describes two Kidin-Hutran attacks. In his first raid, he crossed the Tigris, sacked Der and Nippur and deposed the Babylonian king, Enlil-nadin-shumi. Later on, during the reign of Adad-shuma-iddina, he attacked Babylonia again, striking Marad and Isin
